description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git-http-backend' functionality, specifically testing server responses and request handling in a Git HTTP backend environment without a server. It contains test functions, configuration checks, and assertions for expected behavior.

methods.name: run_backend
methods.description: Executes the git http-backend command with specified query string and path, capturing output and error streams.

methods.name: GET
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request simulation to the backend and verifies the response status.

methods.name: POST
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request simulation to the backend with specified content and verifies the response status.

methods.name: expect_aliased
methods.description: Tests if the backend response indicates an alias error or not, based on the provided parameter.
